ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, irregular contiguous white mottled region occupying the medial and distal sections of the left lobe. Right lobe exhibits predominantly low-intensity black pixels with sparse, high-intensity linear streaks and localized mottling near the tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with a wide vertex angle; depth is approximately 15% of the total fluke vertical height at that center point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations (saw-tooth pattern) with pixel amplitudes ranging from 2 to 8 pixels along the entire trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex upward curvature on the superior edges of both lobes, tapering to acute points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular high-contrast white clusters (potential barnacle scars) localized on the extreme distal tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct, unaligned white linear tracks (rake marks) crossing the central dark pigment and the right lobe area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent horizontal and diagonal white linear rake marks visible against the dark pigmentation of the right lobe and center fluke region.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, 'tattered' appearance of the extreme distal tip of the left lobe with concentrated high-contrast pixel clusters.
